# Finish: PR acme/widget#42, row 1 (push to the PR branch)

**Verification and task evidence (captured before the strip)**
- Scoped set: `test-timeout`, `test-retry`, `lint`, `format`. All four passed at clean HEAD `cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc`.
- Task evidence: T1–T4 and T8 states recorded.

**Order of operations**

```bash
# 1. Refetch threads (N=1): the paginated pr-head query, -F o=acme -F r=widget -F n=42, filtered to isResolved == false.
# 2. Count naming commits for each thread:
git -C "$WORKTREE" log --first-parent --format=%h --grep '<thread id>' bbbbbbb..HEAD
# 3. Strip the plan (the guarded loop over the task plan and the ledger), then seal:
node <bin>/gauntlet-telemetry-seal.mjs --worktree "$WORKTREE" --option pr --base origin/main --spec doc/specs/rework.md
#    -> sealed .pi/gauntlet/telemetry/doc/specs/rework.yaml   (printed verbatim)
# 4. Create the missing local ref:
git -C "$WORKTREE" update-ref refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-42 aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
# 5. Push, non-force:
git -C "$WORKTREE" push --no-follow-tags origin HEAD:refs/heads/fix-timeout
# 6. FETCH the description fresh, decoded without trimming:
gh pr view 42 -R acme/widget --json body      # -> "Original description\n"
SCRATCH=$(mktemp)                              # outside the repo
# 7. EDIT the description:
gh pr edit 42 -R acme/widget --body-file "$SCRATCH"
```

The seal measures the whole PR against `origin/main`, not just the rework.

**Thread dispositions**

| Thread | Disposition |
|---|---|
| T1 | `fixed in ddddddd` |
| T2 | `fixed (task "<T2 title>" complete; no single commit names T2)` (zero naming commits) |
| T3 | `fixed (task "<T3 title>" complete; no single commit names T3)` (two naming commits) |
| T4 | `still open` (task incomplete; a naming commit or file touch is not proof) |
| T5 | `still open` (no task; a path match is not proof) |
| T6 | `still open` (recorded keep open) |
| T7 | `declined - incompatible API` |
| T8 | `still open` (newly opened) |
| T9 | omitted (now resolved on GitHub) |

Fetch outcomes when the refetch does not return threads:
- Empty fetch (independent case): `Threads: none`.
- Failed fetch (independent case): `Threads: not fetched (<gh error>)`.

**Scratch file bytes**

The file holds `Original description\n`, exactly as fetched, then one blank line, then:

```markdown
## Rework

Before: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa (local ref `refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-42` in the rework checkout; the SHA is the portable handle and stays on origin because the push was not forced)
Spec: doc/specs/rework.md at <pushed HEAD7>
Keeps: retry behavior
Changes: repair timeout
Dropped claims: none
Verification: scoped - test-timeout, test-retry, lint, format; CI on this push holds the full run. Telemetry: whole PR against main.
Threads:
- <T1 path:line> - fixed in ddddddd
- <T2 path:line> - fixed (task "<T2 title>" complete; no single commit names T2)
- <T3 path:line> - fixed (task "<T3 title>" complete; no single commit names T3)
- <T4 path:line> - still open
- <T5 path:line> - still open
- <T6 path:line> - still open
- <T7 path:line> - declined - incompatible API
- <T8 path:line> - still open
```

- There is no `Absorbs:` line and the Threads list is unlabeled, because N=1.
- There is no `supersedes the description above` line: dropped claims are none, so the original claims stand.
- The original bytes are kept and the block is appended; nothing is replaced.

**Independent failure outcomes** (no retry, no force, no thread replies, no merges, no ticket changes, no closure question)

| Failure | Effect |
|---|---|
| Strip fails | Stop before the seal. Report the git error. There is no ref, push, or body change. The worktree is preserved and the user decides. |
| Seal exits nonzero | Quote `seal failed record: denied` (exit 1; the pre-seal bytes were restored). Stop before update-ref and push; never land without the seal. The user decides. |
| update-ref fails | Stop and report the error. There is no push and no body change. |
| Push rejected | Report it once. Skip the body fetch and edit, and do not retry or force. Return to the Step 4 menu with preflight recomputed; row 1 may be withheld. The worktree is preserved. |
| Body edit fails after a successful push | Keep the push and report the gh error. Print the `## Rework` block above for manual paste. Never replace the description with only the block. |

Ship is marked complete only when row 1 fully succeeds.

### Shared preparation and landing order

`WORKTREE=/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-timeout`; `PRIMARY=/work/widget`; `FEATURE=fix-timeout`.

Before stripping, capture the executable verification set (`test-timeout`, `test-retry`, `lint`, `format`) and accepted-complete task/thread evidence. All four passed at clean `cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc`.

Refetch threads:
```bash
gh api graphql --paginate -f query='query($o:String!,$r:String!,$n:Int!,$endCursor:String){repository(owner:$o,name:$r){pullRequest(number:$n){reviewThreads(first:100,after:$endCursor){pageInfo{hasNextPage endCursor} nodes{id isResolved isOutdated path line originalLine comments(first:100){pageInfo{hasNextPage endCursor} totalCount nodes{url body author{login} createdAt}}}}}}}' -F o=acme -F r=widget -F n=42
```
Fetch any additional comment pages separately per thread. Retain locations and all replies; omit now-resolved T9.

Count naming commits per thread:
```bash
git -C "$WORKTREE" log --first-parent --format=%h --grep '<thread id>' bbbbbbb..HEAD
```

| Thread | Disposition |
|---|---|
| T1 | fixed in ddddddd |
| T2 | fixed (task "\<T2 title>" complete; no single commit names T2) |
| T3 | fixed (task "\<T3 title>" complete; no single commit names T3) |
| T4 | still open — incomplete task |
| T5 | still open — missing task |
| T6 | still open |
| T7 | declined - incompatible API |
| T8 | still open |

Naming commits or touched paths alone prove nothing. Actual captured task titles replace the placeholders above.

Read the artifact’s `**Spec:**` value before removing it. Resolve configured sibling plan directories; remove tracked basename-task and `rework-ledger.md` candidates, committing each removal with `Remove ephemeral plan doc`. Preserve spec and telemetry.

Then, strictly in order:
```bash
node <bin>/gauntlet-telemetry-seal.mjs --worktree "$WORKTREE" --option pr --base origin/main --spec doc/specs/rework.md
git -C "$WORKTREE" update-ref refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-42 aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
git -C "$WORKTREE" push --no-follow-tags origin HEAD:refs/heads/fix-timeout
```
The missing original ref is created here. Save the successfully pushed HEAD as `PUSHED_HEAD`.

Fresh body FETCH:
```bash
gh pr view 42 -R acme/widget --json body
```
Decode without trimming or command substitution. Create an outside-repository scratch file with `mktemp`; write these complete bytes, substituting the pushed HEAD7 and fetched locations/titles:

```text
Original description

## Rework

Before: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa (local ref `refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-42` in the rework checkout; the SHA is the portable handle and stays on origin because the push was not forced)
Spec: doc/specs/rework.md at <PUSHED_HEAD7>
Keeps: retry behavior
Changes: repair timeout
Dropped claims: none
Verification: scoped - test-timeout; test-retry; lint; format; CI on this push holds the full run. Telemetry: whole PR against main.
Threads:
- <T1 location> - fixed in ddddddd
- <T2 location> - fixed (task "<T2 title>" complete; no single commit names T2)
- <T3 location> - fixed (task "<T3 title>" complete; no single commit names T3)
- <T4 location> - still open
- <T5 location> - still open
- <T6 location> - still open
- <T7 location> - declined - incompatible API
- <T8 location> - still open
```

No original claims were dropped: omit `supersedes the description above`; preserve original bytes regardless.

Fresh EDIT:
```bash
gh pr edit 42 -R acme/widget --body-file "$SCRATCH"
```

Independent thread outcomes replace the entire list with `Threads: none` or `Threads: not fetched (<reason>)`.

### Independent failure deltas

- **Strip fails:** stop; no seal/ref/push/body operations.
- **Seal fails:** quote `seal failed record: denied`; stop before ref/push. User decides.
- **Ref update fails:** report error; stop before push.
- **Push rejected:** report once; skip body editing; preserve worktree; return to menu without retry/force.
- **Body edit fails:** retain successful push; report error and print the complete Rework block for manual paste; skip closure.

On success, complete ship and print seal stdout verbatim. No thread replies, merges, ticket changes, or worktree cleanup.
